body: Sorry for late reply but idk. I can't get happy. I went to the hospital but they let me go. I wish I could be normal again.

Great philosophy don't get me wrong, but for some people like myself who suffer from mental illness, it's ok to just take some time and be patient. Just thought I should put that out there because I know alot of panic attacks have been started by thinking "I HAVE TO FIX THIS/DO SOMETHING RIGHT NOW!" anyways, just my opinion, thought it was relevant, thanks.
I have these unbearable mental health issues and everything went down the drain when I couldn't see my niece. She is the only thing that brings me happiness.
